text:
maria: Quick preflight sync Thurs 11am PT to align on adapter onramp + marketplace packaging for LangChain/LlamaIndex + gateway partners. Aim: finalize manifest schema, packaging artifacts, and announcement gating. RSVP pls.

alex: Ill be there. Can we also confirm HW partner validation steps (NVIDIA / custom quantized builds)? Need to know what we certify vs what partner supports.

sam: Good call. From SDK side we want to avoid breaking fields. Proposal: manifest v1 keep legacy `alias` as optional and add `model_family` required. Backwards compat shim lives in gateway adapter.

lina: For SIs: we need a runbook for customer cutover + preflight checklist (network egress rules, KMS integration, cert pinning). I'll paste a condensed checklist tomorrow.

devon: Partner Eng will bring packaging examples for cloud marketplaces (AWS/Azure/GCP) and a hardware compatibility matrix. Minimal demo CLI to validate a package: 

```
rw-pack validate --package ./bundle.tgz --checks manifest,otel,signing
```

We'll recommend signed bundles for marketplace listings.

jonathan: Tracing note: we should mandate OTel resource attributes: service.name=redwood.connector, rw.partner.id, rw.bundle.version so partner traces can stitch. I'll attach a short policy doc.

maria: Also need to decide announcement cadence: joint blog + marketplace listing on same day or stagger? Partners usually prefer same-day embargo for marketing impact. Thoughts?

alex: Recommend staggered: marketplace listing + cert first week, then joint blog + webinars 2 weeks later. Gives us time to monitor canary telemetry.

sam: Action items: Ill draft manifest v1 with migration notes (eta Wed). Devon: package validator PR? Lina: SI cutover checklist. Maria: coordinate partner comms and embargo window.

partner-bot: Reminder: "Adapter onramp preflight" Thurs 11:00 PT (organizer: maria).

maria: If anyone wants to invite LangChain/LlamaIndex folks, DM me names. I'll loop them into the preflight and the post-listing QA window.

alex: Thanks all . We'll record the meeting and post artifacts to the partners repo.
